title: leucas montana f. wightii
intro: Leucas montana f. wightii, commonly known as "Devil's Claw Vine", is a plant species that belongs to the family Lamiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, pain, and fever, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Leucas montana f. wightii include anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
